svg.text: Department of Physics · University of Abuja · Study · Research · Grow · Make an Impact
Always follow University PG guidelines and departmental additions.
Use the departmental templates for proposals and other submissions.
Attend all seminars and training sessions.
Maintain regular communication with your supervisor and the PG coordinator.
Gate – an approval or decision is required before moving to the next step
